# Real-Time
 People and Company Data API

## Reliable High-Performance Data API at a Low Cost

Complete

Scrape profiles, companies, job listings, data seamlessly with full coverage and accuracy.

Developer-first

Built for developers with an easy-to-use API, clear documentation, and quick integration support.

Real-time

Access the latest data instantly, ensuring fresh, up-to-date insights without delays.

Reliable & scalable

Designed for high-volume use, handling millions of requests efficiently with 99.9% uptime.

High-performance

Fast response times deliver data in seconds, optimizing speed for demanding applications.

Low-cost

Affordable web data without overspending on scraping APIs.

## Reliable real-time scraping

We implement multi-retries and smart proxy rotation to ensure highest success rates.
The uptime is monitored by the [third-party ping ](https://stats.uptimerobot.com/Z48bcKbKjI)that calls the scraping API every minute 24/7.

Pay-As-You-Go pricing. No Subscriptions.

Get 100% of what you paid for, on your schedule, without the pressure of a monthly deadline.
